resources.string: Configure Dot call

After explicit launch, navigates only within ChatGPT and attempts one call-button click for your selected Dot, then checks a configured call-screen marker. Stops within 30 seconds. Reads screen labels, but does not store chat content, record audio, send messages, or use the internet. Configure and verify labels before enabling.

Open Voice to Dot from a Samsung routine to start the configured Dot call in ChatGPT. Unlock the phone first. Enable this accessibility service manually, configure the exact controls, and authorize automatic calling.\n\nAccessibility can read and control ChatGPT screens for up to 30 seconds after launch. No internet permission, recording, chat logs, or backups. Settings remain on this device. Uncheck authorization and save to revoke it. Call-screen detection does not prove audible connection.
